theorems.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid k)) (h : ℝ), 0 < h → IsCompact K → K ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid k) h → ∃ η : Euclid k → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) η ∧ HasCompactSupport η ∧ tsupport η ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid k) h ∧ ∀ w ∈ K, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 w, η y = 1
